target.title: fix(diagnostics): expose zero-output context pressure
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Long-running sessions can terminate a model call with explicit zero output or zero tool calls as context pressure reaches the effective window. OpenClaw's diagnostics dropped those zero values, so operators could not distinguish a real zero-output terminal call from missing telemetry.

Fixes #100113.

Related recovery work: #100042 and #100077.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Preserve explicit zero token and tool-call values in model-call and aggregate OTEL spans.
- Add sanitized terminal facts: stop reason, content-block count, tool-call count, effective-window overflow detection, and prompt utilization.
- Classify overflow with the same effective context budget used by the runtime recovery path.
- Project Codex usage and terminal facts from its app-server result, including tool counts from canonical projected turn items.
- Keep absent usage absent rather than synthesizing zero.

## User Impact

OTEL traces can now identify the failure signature behind zero-output/tool-call turns near context exhaustion without capturing model content. This improves diagnosis of long-session context failures without changing retries, compaction, provider routing, configuration, or persisted state.

## Evidence

- Final autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Crabbox/Testbox `tbx_01kwqskghftc0ax485hc22k08r`, Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28723926807:
  - core typecheck passed
  - core-test typecheck passed
  - extension typecheck passed
  - docs MDX validation passed
  - 125 focused tests passed across overflow classification, embedded model-call diagnostics, Codex diagnostics, and OTEL export
- Post-rebase local proof:
  - 125 focused tests passed
  - docs MDX validation passed
  - `oxfmt --check` passed for all touched files
  - `git diff --check` passed
- Direct upstream Codex contract checked for `thread/tokenUsage/updated`, turn completion, and separate command/MCP/dynamic tool-call items.

The repo `check:changed` Testbox overlay was also attempted. Its delegated changed-gate sync repeatedly removed the tracked `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/cli.ts` file and failed on that unrelated missing module after core and core-test typechecks passed. The final proof avoids that sync defect by running the equivalent typecheck/docs/test lanes directly on a fresh full-sync lease.
